shortDescription: SpaceX NASDAQ:SPCX President Gwynne Shotwell said in an X post on Friday that more than 2 million of the company's shares will be distributed to eligible children through "Trump Accounts" in December.Here are some more details:

children: President Gwynne Shotwell said in an X post on Friday that more than 2 million of the company's shares will be distributed to eligible children through "Trump Accounts" in December.
The initial gift of shares, currently being transferred to escrow, will go to children aged 11 to 17 living in ZIP codes with a median family income of $57,000 or less, Shotwell said
Children living in ZIP codes with too few residents for median family income data to be reported will also be eligible
Eligible families should receive a notice by Monday, she said

A separate gift is expected to be finalized in coming weeks for eligible children in military families serving overseas, children in foster care, and children whose family income is $90,000 or less, living in eligible Texas counties
CEO Elon Musk said earlier this month that SpaceX and Tesla
had formed special committees to explore a potential merger, though he said the panels had not agreed upon transaction terms and might never do so

title: SpaceX's Shotwell says 2 million shares to be gifted to children's Trump Accounts
